claim_boundary: The original 2019 Hash Ribbons article specifies one- and two-month simple moving averages of daily Bitcoin hash rate and reports recovery when the fast average crosses above the slow average. It also shows a separate price-confirmed construction. This family tests only the hash-only health state with conservative source availability; it does not import the article's historical returns or authorize adding price confirmation after results.

primary_sources.title: Hash Ribbons & Bitcoin Bottoms
primary_sources.finding: The indicator creator defines a one-month and two-month simple-moving-average crossover of daily Bitcoin hash rate, treating the fast average crossing above the slow average as miner recovery.

primary_sources.title: A System Dynamics Model of Bitcoin: Mining as an Efficient Market and the Possibility of Peak Hash
primary_sources.finding: The model treats hash-rate adjustment as a delayed response to mining profitability, including Bitcoin price, subsidy, fees, energy cost and hardware constraints.

primary_sources.title: Bitcoin price dynamics and internal-external determinants
primary_sources.finding: The study reports that hash-rate influence is regime dependent and notes evidence that Bitcoin price can lead hash rate, so a ribbon may be a lagging price-state proxy outside miner-capitulation periods.

primary_sources.title: Coin Metrics Community API reviewed Bitcoin HashRate history
primary_sources.finding: The previously sealed no-key reviewed daily HashRate response supplies one present-vintage 2018-2024 source corpus with explicit raw and normalized hashes.

deduplication_contract.economic_action_difference: The closed family vetoed otherwise unchanged DRA entries for seven days. This family controls a standalone full-capital BTC-or-cash state every available day and has no DRA inventory.
deduplication_contract.pre_economic_gate: At the old Wednesday weekly decision clocks, require the two binary states to disagree on at least 15 percent of Design comparisons and 10 percent of Validation comparisons; otherwise close as a duplicate before BTC economics.
deduplication_contract.price_repackaging_gate: Require absolute binary phi correlation between the ribbon health state and lagged BTC 60-complete-day positive price trend at most 0.80 in Design and Validation before matched-capital economics may count.

adversarial_prior: Hash rate is an estimate derived from observed block production and can be noisy even when actual deployed hardware is unchanged.
Mining profitability depends materially on BTC price, subsidy, fees, energy and hardware efficiency, so the health state may lag the asset it attempts to predict.
The original article selected historical recovery episodes and later added a price-momentum confirmation; neither result is independent evidence for this repository window.
A largely healthy state can resemble buy-and-hold and claim small drawdown differences without independent return contribution.
Halvings, the 2021 China mining relocation and hardware cycles can dominate a small number of transitions and destroy annual breadth.
stop_conditions: Before any ribbon or BTC outcome is calculated, freeze one hypothesis, one source-reuse manifest, one runner and all source, timing, support, deduplication, price-repackaging, Design, Validation, cost, breadth, concentration, holding and determinism gates.
Reject before economics if the sealed normalized source, raw source, source bundle, BTC corpus or any bound runner support hash differs; do not reacquire or repair data.

Reject before economics if either window lacks both states or transitions, the new state is insufficiently different from the closed 28-day family, or it is too correlated with lagged BTC price trend.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE on any economic or path-risk gate failure and permanently close the exact 30/60, plus-three-day, full-capital long-or-cash family.

Do not add the original article's 10/20 price confirmation, choose only recovery crossings, extend holding, change moving-average periods, lag, equality, source, weight, direction, cost or gate after outcomes.
Do not open post-2024 outcomes. A historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and needs one independent sealed OOS.
